cc:Work.dc:title: PressPatrol hand-drawn pipeline
cc:Work.dc:description: Six numbered steps: collect and apply rules, capture browser evidence, re-extract saved HTML, gated API review, annotate and export, and human verification. Failed-site search is a separate follow-up.
